selection.limits: Known item/title/pixel links include supplied unreviewed metadata bridges. Strata are weak source tags, not visual labels; unknown is not a negative. Protects supplied groups only, not proof of product independence.

audit.selection: Before inference, seed197: one random observation per weak sampling stratum plus two random remaining observations; display order shuffled. Not selected by output correctness.

limits: Sampling strata and future automatic tags are not human ground truth. The full 96 are annotation targets, not a held-out evaluation set. Four prior-human-pool-linked observations have an additional future-training reservation.
